definitions.explanation: The act of keeping, maintaining, or holding onto something.

examples.japanese: {記録|きろく}を{保持|ほじ}する。
{健康|けんこう}を{保持|ほじ}する{努力|どりょく}をする。
examples.english: To make efforts to maintain health.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{記録|きろく}{保持者|ほじしゃ}だ。

notes:
{保持|ほじ} means to retain, maintain, or hold onto something—often a record, status, or condition.

COMPONENTS:
{保|ほ} (preserve) + {持|じ} (hold) = retention, maintenance

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記録|きろく}を{保持|ほじ}する: to hold a record
- {記録|きろく}{保持者|ほじしゃ}: record holder
- {世界|せかい}{記録|きろく}{保持者|ほじしゃ}: world record holder
- {健康|けんこう}を{保持|ほじ}する: to maintain health
- {体力|たいりょく}を{保持|ほじ}する: to maintain physical strength
- {姿勢|しせい}を{保持|ほじ}する: to maintain posture

RELATED TERMS:
- {維持|いじ}: maintenance (similar meaning)
- {保存|ほぞん}: preservation (of items/files)
- {持続|じぞく}: continuation, sustainability

NOTE:
{保持|ほじ}する is the suru-verb form for 'to maintain/retain.'
